tables.name: security_auth_credentials
columns: local_user_profile_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES local_user_profiles(local_user_profile_id) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT
verifier_phc TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(verifier_phc) BETWEEN 32 AND 1024)
rules: password change/reset replaces verifier and increments security_revision atomically with audit

tables.name: security_auto_login
columns: enabled INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(enabled IN (0,1))
rules: enabled=1 requires corresponding owner-only DPAPI envelope to be validated at use
disable invalidates verifier and removes protected envelope after commit-safe handoff

tables.name: managed_backup_catalog
columns: state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(state IN ('building','verifying','verified','failed','pruned','restored'))
artifact_sha256 BLOB CHECK(artifact_sha256 IS NULL OR length(artifact_sha256)=32)
rules: catalog is management evidence, not operational domain history
pruned retains catalog identity/digest/chronology but artifact is absent
portable operator-selected exports are not rows here and are never auto-pruned

forbidden_storage: portable or managed backup plaintext key
